scenario.claim_text: A contractor asks for full retention release after the owner starts using the building, but unpaid supplier claims remain and the guarantee bond has not been posted. The source-safe answer is to keep the request tied to the governing contract: CIAP Document 102 connects release of retention to the Period of Making Good of Known Defects, posting of the guarantee bond, and lien protection. Early occupancy or substantial completion does not by itself erase those close-out conditions.
